name: taskflow
description: Plan and run your Taskthread tasks from ChatGPT: list, create, update and complete tasks, search your notes and get a daily briefing, limited to the boards you approve.

interface.longDescription:
Taskthread is a personal task app with kanban boards, a calendar, an hour-by-hour day plan and meeting notes, on the web, iPhone and Android. This app lets ChatGPT work on your Taskthread account directly.

What ChatGPT can do:
- See your boards and their tasks, open a task with its description and subtasks, and search across tasks, list items and meeting notes.
- Create tasks in the right board and column, change titles, descriptions, priorities and due dates, move a task between boards, and mark tasks done.
- Get a daily briefing: what is overdue, due soon or stalled, and which people you met still have open action items.
- Read your meeting notes, and save new meeting notes whose action items arrive in Taskthread as proposals you accept or dismiss.
- Read the files attached to a task, and attach new ones.
- Pick up work like a teammate: claim a task so another assistant does not take it too, leave a working note or comment, and hand a task off with a note on what is left.

What it cannot do: it never deletes anything. Finishing a task moves it to the done column, which you can undo.

You stay in control. When you connect, you choose which boards ChatGPT may use; an assistant limited to some boards cannot read your inbox, meeting notes or personal files. Every change ChatGPT makes is shown in the task's history under its own name. The Connected AIs screen (Profile or Assistant, on web and mobile) lists every connected assistant, lets you change its boards, and disconnects it at once. Changing your password also signs out every connected assistant.

Dates are handled by Taskthread, not guessed by the model: "tomorrow" or "+3d" is resolved in your own timezone.

You need a Taskthread account to use this app.
capabilities: Read and search tasks, boards and meeting notes
Daily briefing of overdue, due-soon and stalled work
Save meeting notes with proposed action items
defaultPrompt: What's overdue in my Taskthread, and what should I do first today?
Turn these meeting notes into Taskthread tasks with due dates.
Move everything due this week in my Work board to next Monday.

positive.expected_behavior: Shows how many tasks are overdue, due today and stalled, and lists the top tasks with their board and due date.

positive.prompt: List my boards and the open tasks in the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's boards, then the open tasks of the first board with their column and due date.

positive.description: Create a task with a relative due date
positive.prompt: Add a task 'Call the bank' due tomorrow in my Personal board.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the task and replies with its id. In the Taskthread app it appears in the Personal board with tomorrow's date in the user's timezone.
Finds the task and moves it to the done column. Asking again is safe: the task stays done and nothing else changes.

positive.description: Pick up and hand off a task
positive.prompt: Pick up my oldest open task, leave a note on where you stopped, and hand it back to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Claims the task, saves a working note, and hands it back with a note on what is left. The task's history in the app shows each step under the assistant's name.

negative.description: Deleting is not possible: the app has no delete tool. ChatGPT should say it cannot delete and offer to complete or move the work instead.
negative.prompt: Delete my Personal board and everything in it.

negative.description: A connection limited to some boards cannot read the inbox. Connect with only one board selected on the consent screen; the request is refused with an explanation instead of returning data.
Unknown board: no task is created in a guessed place. ChatGPT should report that no board matches and list the boards that exist.
negative.prompt: Create a task 'Test' in my board called Nope.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: TaskFlow is now Taskthread: new name, new address (taskthread.denegra.ai) and "boards" instead of "flows". The tools and what they do are unchanged.

tr-TR.subtitle: Görevlerin, AI ile planlı
tr-TR.description: Taskthread; kanban panoları, takvim, saat saat gün planı ve toplantı notları olan kişisel bir görev uygulamasıdır (web, iPhone, Android). Bu uygulama ChatGPT'nin Taskthread hesabında doğrudan çalışmasını sağlar: panolarını ve görevlerini görür, görev oluşturur, günceller ve tamamlar, gecikenleri ve yaklaşanları özetler, toplantı notlarını okur ve kaydeder. Hiçbir şeyi silmez; biten görev, geri alınabilen Tamamlandı sütununa taşınır. Bağlanırken ChatGPT'nin hangi panoları kullanacağını sen seçersin ve bağlantıyı istediğin an kesebilirsin. Kullanmak için bir Taskthread hesabı gerekir.
